top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Track US Losses Before Nvidia Results: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks fell, tracking declines on Wall Street as investors remained wary of the AI trade ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s widely anticipated earnings and Anthropic PBC’s expected market debut.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China’s Buyback Push Struggles to Put a Floor Under Stocks
top_signals.summary: Chinese companies are tapping only a fraction of loans provided by Beijing for stock buybacks, an indication that the latest effort to support markets is faltering.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
